TaskDescription: Trial-level Trust game performed outside the scanner. One row per source trial, including missed responses. These recordings are task choices, not the pre/post partner ratings.
Instructions: Select one of the displayed investment amounts using the response controls.
AcquisitionSelectionRule: Only unambiguous single-acquisition source logs are exported automatically. Repeated acquisitions and exact cross-owner copies require identity review.

trial_number.Description: One-based recorded trial order within the run.

partner.Description: Partner condition recorded by the presentation script.

response.Description: Recorded response button (2 or 3); n/a for a missed response. See investment and choice for the selected option.

response_time.Description: Response latency recorded in the source log; n/a for missed responses.

decision_onset_time.Description: Source choice-onset timestamp relative to the PsychoPy run clock. Not an MRI acquisition timestamp.

response_onset_time.Description: Source response timestamp relative to the run clock; n/a for missed responses.

investment.Description: Selected investment from the eight-dollar endowment; zero is a valid choice, n/a means missed response.

choice.Description: Selected option relative to the two displayed amounts.

left_option.Description: Investment amount offered on the left.

right_option.Description: Investment amount offered on the right.

reciprocate.Description: Scheduled reciprocity condition, retained even if the participant did not invest or respond. Does not establish that an outcome was displayed.

outcome_onset_time.Description: Outcome-onset timestamp as recorded by the source script, relative to the run clock. Missing sentinels become n/a; timestamps are not reconstructed.

outcome_offset_time.Description: Outcome-offset timestamp as recorded by the source script, relative to the run clock.
